WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) rn, SUM(quantity_returned) rq, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b.format, b.category='ZZ Test' AS test, b.store_id=999 AS s999, count(*) lines, SUM(b.net_amount) sold, SUM(r.rn) refunded, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rq>b.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_returned, SUM(CASE WHEN r.n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi, SUM(CASE WHEN b.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM base b LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
